_comment: Labelled queries for eval_retrieval.py. 'expect' = source files that count as a correct hit (any of them). 'expect': [] means NO document should be retrieved (off-topic, or library-related but genuinely not covered by the corpus). Many in-domain queries are deliberate paraphrases that share few words with the document, so a semantic embedding model is needed to pass them.
